what: Bottom-right back-to-top button — the ”PAGETOP” text around the circle spins upright once every 14 seconds. After scrolling even a little it appears from .9x to 1x over .22s ease, and hides again when the footer’s top edge reaches the bottom of the screen. On hover the text circle shrinks to .95x over .295s and the center arrow flattens around its bottom every 1 second, slides out upward and comes back up from below (cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94)). Pressing it scrolls smoothly to the top.

options.repeat: How many times it wraps per turn, default 3
options.after: Selector for the element that hides on contact, default nearest footer
options.--fx-size · --fx-right · --fx-bottom: Button diameter · right · bottom margin (via style), default 6.375rem · 2.625rem · 2rem
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Surrounding text plate (optional) — if absent, the part draws it from text
